comparison: Rejected drawing had an upright stick with a stub arm, the baby as a vertical bar beside a floating ring, and a loose line; no one was changing anyone. The original shows a parent reaching down to a baby lying on its back, legs raised, on a changing table.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Parent reaches to the baby's hips; the baby lies on a legged table with a raised leg and its head level beside its torso; reads as a diaper change at 48. Bent-over variant kept in attempts/.
omissions: Parent's skirt, the baby's second leg and arms; parent stands upright (a bent pose needs the head 12 units beside a level neck).
lucide_reference: No direct Lucide match; stick figures from full_body_ref.png.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png; parent head outline y=14 to neck (12,22) = 8 centerline / 4 ink, straight above; baby head outline x=36 to torso end (28,27) = 8, level beside.
